title: Dairy-Free Coconut Macaroon Cookies
description: Coconut macaroons made with just a few ingredients: dairy-free, lactose-free, gluten-free and wheat-free.

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Line 2 large baking sheets with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, mix the coconut, sugar and salt.
Add the egg whites and vanilla and mix until well combined.
With your hands, shape the mixture into small mounds of about 1½ to 2 tablespoons each, setting them on the baking sheets as you go.
Bake until just the peaks are light golden brown, about 12 to 15 minutes, turning the pans halfway through for even baking.
Cool completely on a wire rack. Serve at room temperature.
